//: The backend config: src/, test/, tools/. Exactly what tsconfig.json held through
It is separate from the root config for one load-bearing reason: `lib` here does
NOT include DOM. That is what makes a bare `fetch`, `XMLHttpRequest` or
`WebSocket` in backend code a TYPE error as well as an ESLint error and an AST-
scanner failure. Letting Next's DOM lib leak into src/ would quietly remove one of
the three layers F0 built to keep FetchPolicyGate the only network path.
`npm run typecheck` runs this first, then the root (UI) config.
